# Presentation

This is the data preparation code for the paper "Market Justice Preferences and the Dynamic Role of Objective and Subjective Status: A
           Longitudinal Multilevel Approach". The prepared dataset is `ELSOC_Long_2016_2023_1.00.RData`.

```{r}
#| label: set
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, include = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

table_format <- if(is_html_output()) {
  "html"
} else if(is_latex_output()) {
  "latex"
}
table_format2 <- if(is_html_output()) {
  T
} else if(is_latex_output()) {
  F
}

options(kableExtra.html.bsTable = T)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

# Processing

```{r}

elsoc_long_2016_2023[elsoc_long_2016_2023 ==-999] <- NA
elsoc_long_2016_2023[elsoc_long_2016_2023 ==-888] <- NA
elsoc_long_2016_2023[elsoc_long_2016_2023 ==-777] <- NA
elsoc_long_2016_2023[elsoc_long_2016_2023 ==-666] <- NA

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>% 
  mutate(just_pension = d02_01,
         just_educ = d02_02,
         just_salud = d02_03, 
         merit_effort = c18_09,
         merit_talent = c18_10, 
         age = m0_edad, m01, 
         sex = m0_sexo, 
         ideo = c15,
         protest = c08_02,
         retiro_2021 = m63_02,
         ess = d01_01,
         ess_og = d01_02,
         ess_hijos = d01_03) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  sjlabelled::drop_labels(., drop.na = FALSE)
```


```{r}
#| label: Market Justice Preferences

# Average index (1-5) of pension, education and healthcare market justice.
# Computed on the numeric items, before they are recoded to factors.
elsoc_long_2016_2023$mjp_index <- rowMeans(
  elsoc_long_2016_2023[, c("just_pension", "just_educ", "just_salud")],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

elsoc_long_2016_2023$mjp_index <- sjlabelled::set_label(elsoc_long_2016_2023$mjp_index,
                        label = "Market justice preferences index")

sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$mjp_index)

elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_pension <- car::recode(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_pension, 
recodes = c("1='Strongly disagree'; 2='Disagree'; 3='Neither agree nor disagree'; 4='Agree'; 5='Strongly agree'"), 
levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neither agree nor disagree", "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
as.factor = T)
                                                 
elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_pension <- sjlabelled::set_label(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_pension, 
                        label = "Pension market justice")

elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_educ <- car::recode(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_educ, 
recodes = c("1='Strongly disagree'; 2='Disagree'; 3='Neither agree nor disagree'; 4='Agree'; 5='Strongly agree'"), 
levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neither agree nor disagree", "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
as.factor = T)
                                                 
elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_educ <- sjlabelled::set_label(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_educ, 
                        label = "Education market justice")

elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_salud <- car::recode(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_salud, 
recodes = c("1='Strongly disagree'; 2='Disagree'; 3='Neither agree nor disagree'; 4='Agree'; 5='Strongly agree'"), 
levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neither agree nor disagree", "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
as.factor = T)
                                                 
elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_salud <- sjlabelled::set_label(elsoc_long_2016_2023$just_salud, 
                        label = "Healthcare market justice")
```


```{r}
#| label: Meritocracy

frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$merit_effort)
```

```{r}
#| label: income

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>% 
 mutate(ola = case_when(ola == 1 ~ 2016,
                        ola == 2 ~ 2017,
                        ola == 3 ~ 2018,
                        ola == 4 ~ 2019,
                        ola == 5 ~ 2021,
                        ola == 6 ~ 2022,
                        ola == 7 ~ 2023))

# Impute midpoint of income ranges
elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30_rec <-
  as.numeric(car::recode(
    elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30,
    "1=110000;2=251000;3=305000;4=355000;5=400000;
     6=445000;7=490000;8=535000;9=585000;10=640000;11=700000;12=765000;
     13=845000;14=935000;15=1040000;16=1180000;17=1375000;18=1670000;
     19=2275000;20=2700000;NA=NA;c(-888,-999)=NA"
  ))

# Impute midpoint of income ranges (2021)
elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30b_rec <-
  as.numeric(car::recode(
    elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30b,
    "1=125000;2=300000;3=400000;4=575000;5=700000;NA=NA;c(-888,-999)=NA"
  ))

sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30_rec)
sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30b_rec)

# Recode DK/DA of income to NA
elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_rec <-
  as.numeric(car::recode(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29, "c(-888,-999)=NA"))

# Replace missing continuous income with imputed midpoints
elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp <- ifelse(!is.na(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_rec), elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_rec, elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30_rec)
summary(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp)

elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp <- ifelse(is.na(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp), elsoc_long_2016_2023$m30b_rec, elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp)
summary(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp)

# Deflate to constant prices --------------------------------------------------
library(rvest)
url <- "https://si3.bcentral.cl/Siete/ES/Siete/Cuadro/CAP_PRECIOS/MN_CAP_PRECIOS/IPC_EMP_2023/638415285164039007?cbFechaInicio=2016&cbFechaTermino=2025&cbFrecuencia=MONTHLY&cbCalculo=NONE&cbFechaBase="

ipc <- url %>%
  read_html() %>%
  html_node("table") %>%
  html_table() %>%
  rename_with(., ~ tolower(gsub(".", "_", .x, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(serie == "Índice IPC General") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(everything(), -serie),
      .fns = ~ as.numeric(str_replace(., ",", "."))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-sel_) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -serie,
    names_to = "ano_mes",
    values_to = "ipc"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate(col = "ano_mes", into = c("mes", "ano"))

ipc <- ipc %>%
  filter(mes == "dic") %>%
  select(ano, ipc) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 8) %>% 
  filter(ano != "2020")

elsoc_long_2016_2023$ola <- as.factor(elsoc_long_2016_2023$ola)

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- left_join(elsoc_long_2016_2023, ipc, by = c("ola" = "ano"))

frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$ipc)

# Build household size -----------------------------------

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  mutate(
    n_hogar = dplyr::case_when(
      ola == "2016" ~ nhogar1,
      ola == "2017" ~ m46_nhogar,
      ola == "2018" ~ m54,
      ola == "2019" ~ m54,
      ola == "2021" ~ m54,
      ola == "2022" ~ m54,
      ola == "2023" ~ m54,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Household size (m54) was not asked in 2022: carry it over from the same
# respondent's adjacent waves (2021, otherwise 2023). Without this, equivalised
# income and its deciles are NA for the whole 2022 wave and na.omit() drops it.
elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(
    n_hogar = if_else(
      ola == "2022" & is.na(n_hogar),
      coalesce(n_hogar[ola == "2021"][1], n_hogar[ola == "2023"][1]),
      n_hogar
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$n_hogar)

# Recode DK/DA of household size to NA
elsoc_long_2016_2023$n_hogar_r <- car::recode(elsoc_long_2016_2023$n_hogar, "c(-888,-999)=NA")
sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$n_hogar_r)

# Equivalised income (square-root scale) --------------------------------------

# Select a reference IPC (e.g., December 2023 as base)
ipc_ref <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  filter(ola == "2023") %>%
  summarise(ipc_ref = median(ipc, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(ipc_ref)

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  mutate(
    # Deflate household income to constant prices (base = 2023 Dec)
    inc_hh_real = m29_imp * (ipc_ref / ipc),
    
    # Equivalence scale: square-root of household size
    eq_size_sqrt = if_else(!is.na(n_hogar_r) & n_hogar_r > 0,
                           sqrt(as.numeric(n_hogar_r)),
                           NA_real_),
    
    # Equivalised household income
    inc_eq_real_sqrt = inc_hh_real / eq_size_sqrt,
    
    # Log equivalised income (for modelling)
    ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt = if_else(!is.na(inc_eq_real_sqrt) & inc_eq_real_sqrt > 0,
                                  log(inc_eq_real_sqrt),
                                  NA_real_)
  )

sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp)
sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_real_sqrt)
sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt)

# Continuous income: equivalised real income in millions of CLP (base = 2023 Dec)
elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_mill <- elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_real_sqrt / 1000000

elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_mill <-
  sjlabelled::set_label(x = elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_mill,
                        label = "Equivalised household income (millions CLP, Dec 2023)")
sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_eq_mill)

# Original per-capita measure for comparison -------------
elsoc_long_2016_2023$ing_pc <- elsoc_long_2016_2023$m29_imp / elsoc_long_2016_2023$n_hogar_r
sjmisc::descr(elsoc_long_2016_2023$ing_pc)

# Income deciles (within-wave, based on equivalised income) -------------------

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  group_by(ola) %>%
  mutate(decile_eq = ntile(inc_eq_real_sqrt, 10)) %>%
  ungroup()

frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq)

# Include missing cases for income groups
elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq1 <- if_else(is.na(elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq), "DNA", as.character(elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq))
elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq1 <- factor(elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq1, levels = c(as.character(1:10), "DNA"))

sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$decile_eq1)

frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$ola)  # ok

elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(decile_eq, decile_eq1),
      .fns = ~ as.factor(.)
    )
  )

# Income groups: Bottom (deciles 1-4), Middle (5-9), Top (10)
elsoc_long_2016_2023 <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>%
  mutate(
    inc_group = case_when(
      as.character(decile_eq) %in% as.character(1:4)  ~ "Bottom",
      as.character(decile_eq) %in% as.character(5:9)  ~ "Middle",
      as.character(decile_eq) == "10"                 ~ "Top"),
    inc_group = factor(inc_group, levels = c("Bottom", "Middle", "Top")),

    # Same grouping, keeping missing cases as "DNA"
    inc_group1 = case_when(
      as.character(decile_eq1) %in% as.character(1:4) ~ "Bottom",
      as.character(decile_eq1) %in% as.character(5:9) ~ "Middle",
      as.character(decile_eq1) == "10"                ~ "Top",
      as.character(decile_eq1) == "DNA"               ~ "DNA"),
    inc_group1 = factor(inc_group1, levels = c("Bottom", "Middle", "Top", "DNA"))
  )

elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group <-
  sjlabelled::set_label(x = elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group,
                        label = "Income group (deciles)")
elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group1 <-
  sjlabelled::set_label(x = elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group1,
                        label = "Income group (deciles), including missing")

sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group)
sjmisc::frq(elsoc_long_2016_2023$inc_group1)

```

```{r}
# Reshape long to wide

df_study1_long <- elsoc_long_2016_2023 %>% 
  select(idencuesta,
         ola,
         muestra,
         ponderador_long_total, 
         segmento, 
         estrato,
         just_pension,
         just_educ,
         just_salud,
         mjp_index,
         merit_effort,
         merit_talent,
         educ,
         educ_4,
         educyear,
         sex,
         age,
         aget,
         ideo,
         ess_og,
         ess_hijos,
         ess,
         decile_eq,
         decile_eq1,
         inc_group,
         inc_group1,
         inc_eq_real_sqrt,
         ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt,
         inc_eq_mill)

vars_invariantes <- c("age", "aget",
                      "sex",
                      "ideo")

df_study1_long_fix <- df_study1_long %>% 
  arrange(idencuesta, muestra, ola) %>%         
  group_by(idencuesta, muestra) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_invariantes),
      ~ {
        v1 <- .x[ola == 1 & !is.na(.x)]
        if (length(v1) > 0) v1[1] else .x
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

frq(df_study1_long_fix$ola) # ok

waves_use <- c("2016","2017","2018","2019","2022","2023")

df_study1_long_fix <- df_study1_long_fix %>% 
  filter(ola %in% waves_use)

```


```{r}

df_unbalanced <- df_study1_long_fix

ids_t7 <- df_study1_long_fix %>%
  filter(ola == "2023") %>%
  distinct(idencuesta) %>%
  pull(idencuesta)

df_t7 <- df_study1_long_fix %>%
  filter(idencuesta %in% ids_t7)

df_ids_balanced <- df_t7 %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  summarise(
    n_olas_distintas = n_distinct(ola),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_olas_distintas == length(waves_use)) %>%   # tiene las 6 olas
  pull(idencuesta)

df_balanced <- df_t7 %>%
  filter(idencuesta %in% df_ids_balanced)

# Número de individuos
n_distinct(df_unbalanced$idencuesta)
n_distinct(df_balanced$idencuesta)

# Distribución por ola
df_unbalanced %>% count(ola)
df_balanced   %>% count(ola)

```

```{r}
#| label: df balanced final proc

df_study1 <- df_balanced %>%
  select(-muestra) %>%
  # na.omit() %>%

  mutate(ola = case_when(ola == "2016" ~ 1,
                         ola == "2017" ~ 2, 
                         ola == "2018" ~ 3,
                         ola == "2019" ~ 4,
                         ola == "2022" ~ 5,
                         ola == "2023" ~ 6)) %>% 
  mutate(ola = as.factor(ola),
         ola_num = as.numeric(ola),
         ola_2=as.numeric(ola)^2)

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%             # Agrupar por el identificador del participante
  mutate(n_participaciones = n()) %>%  # Contar el número de filas (participaciones) por participante
  ungroup()

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>% filter(n_participaciones>1)
```

```{r}

df_study1$merit_effort <- as_numeric(df_study1$merit_effort)
df_study1$merit_talent <- as_numeric(df_study1$merit_talent)

df_study1$decile_eq <- as_numeric(df_study1$decile_eq)
df_study1$dummy_decile10 <- if_else(df_study1$decile_eq >= 10, 1, 0)
df_study1$dummy_educ <- if_else(df_study1$educ == "Universitary", 1, 0)

df_study1$age_2 <- (df_study1$age)^2 

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>% 
  mutate(ola = case_when(ola == 1 ~ "2016",
                         ola == 2 ~ "2017",
                         ola == 3 ~ "2018",
                         ola == 4 ~ "2019",
                         ola == 5 ~ "2022",
                         ola == 6 ~ "2023"),
         ola = factor(ola, levels = c("2016",
                                        "2017",
                                        "2018",
                                        "2019",
                                        "2022",
                                        "2023")))


df_study1 <- df_study1 %>% # WE and BE effects
  group_by(idencuesta) %>% 
  mutate(merit_effort_mean = mean(merit_effort, na.rm = T),
         merit_effort_cwc = merit_effort - merit_effort_mean,
         merit_talent_mean = mean(merit_talent, na.rm = T),
         merit_talent_cwc = merit_talent - merit_talent_mean,
         ess_mean = mean(ess, na.rm = T),
         ess_cwc = ess - ess_mean,
         ess_og_mean = mean(ess_og, na.rm = T),
         ess_og_cwc = ess_og - ess_og_mean,
         ess_hijos_mean = mean(ess_hijos, na.rm = T),
         ess_hijos_cwc = ess_hijos - ess_hijos_mean,       
        dummy_educ_mean = mean(dummy_educ, na.rm = T),
        dummy_educ_cwc = dummy_educ - dummy_educ_mean,       
        dummy_decile10_mean = mean(dummy_decile10, na.rm = T),
        dummy_decile10_cwc = dummy_decile10 - dummy_decile10_mean,
        educyear_mean = mean(educyear, na.rm = T),
        educyear_cwc = educyear - educyear_mean,
        ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt_mean = mean(ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt, na.rm = T),
        ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt_cwc = ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt - ln_inc_eq_real_sqrt_mean,
        decile_eq_mean = mean(decile_eq, na.rm = T),
        decile_eq_cwc = decile_eq - decile_eq_mean,
         ) %>% 
  ungroup()


df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(dummy_decile10_mean = as.integer(any(dummy_decile10 == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
         dummy_educ_mean = as.integer(any(dummy_educ == 1, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

df_study1$just_pension <- as_factor(df_study1$just_pension)
df_study1$just_educ <- as_factor(df_study1$just_educ)
df_study1$just_salud <- as_factor(df_study1$just_salud)

```

```{r}
#| label: new-sss


# Subjective social status index: mean of own, family-of-origin and children's
# status (all 0-10 scales)
sss_vars <- c("ess", "ess_og", "ess_hijos")

# Internal consistency and inter-item correlations
psych::alpha(df_study1[, sss_vars])$total[c("raw_alpha", "std.alpha")]
cor(df_study1[, sss_vars], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


```

```{r}
#| label: sss-mobility

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(mov_dir      = ess - ess_og,
         mov_dir_mean = mean(mov_dir),
         mov_dir_cwc  = mov_dir - mov_dir_mean,
         mov_og       = ess - ess_og_mean,
         mov_og_mean  = mean(mov_og),
         mov_og_cwc   = mov_og - mov_og_mean) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: sss-mobility-expectations

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  mutate(mov_exp = ess_hijos - ess) %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(mov_exp_mean = mean(mov_exp),
         mov_exp_cwc  = mov_exp - mov_exp_mean) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: sss-intergenerational-mobility

df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  mutate(mov_inter = ess_hijos - ess - ess_og) %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(mov_inter_mean = mean(mov_inter),
         mov_inter_cwc  = mov_inter - mov_inter_mean) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: sss-mobility-expectations-origin

# Children's SSS minus family-of-origin SSS: positive values = higher
# expected social mobility
df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  mutate(mov_exp_og = ess_hijos - ess_og) %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(mov_exp_og_mean = mean(mov_exp_og),
         mov_exp_og_cwc  = mov_exp_og - mov_exp_og_mean) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: sss-slope

# SSS trajectory within each person-wave: family of origin (t = 1), own (t = 2)
# and children (t = 3). The OLS slope of ess ~ t over these three points is the
# trajectory (positive = upward). NA if any of the three measures is missing
df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ess_traj = {
    y <- c(ess_og, ess, ess_hijos)
    if (anyNA(y)) NA_real_ else unname(coef(lm(y ~ c(1, 2, 3)))[2])
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

```
